author: NASS
description:
Experience Canada in the 1920s like never before through this fully restored and colorized version of Across Canada by the CPR, an original film produced by the Canadian Government Motion Picture Bureau to promote travel across the country aboard the Canadian Pacific Railway. Using my latest restoration and semantic colorization techniques, I have brought new life to this remarkable footage with a level of realism rarely seen in historical films. This incredible 3,600-mile (5,800 km) journey takes you across Canada from Saint John to Vancouver, passing through Quebec City, Montreal, Ottawa, Toronto, Winnipeg, Regina, Saskatoon, Calgary, Lake Louise, and the breathtaking Canadian Rockies. Step back in time and discover the landscapes, cities, people, and daily life of Canada as they appeared over a century ago. If you enjoy this restoration, please like, comment, and subscribe to support future historical restoration projects.

📽️ Technologies & Techniques Used:
• Advanced video restor
